mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN expense_type = 'FIXED' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0 ) AS fixed_expense_total, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN expense_type = 'VARIABLE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0 ) AS variable_expense_total, COALESCE( SUM(amount), 0 ) AS total_expense FROM expense_transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND transaction_date >= #{startDate} AND transaction_date < #{endDate}
